kept_items.author: Alibaba_Qwen
kept_items.text: Qwen3.8 is launching and going open-weight soon! With a massive 2.4T parameters, this model is continuously evolving. We believe it's one of the most powerful models available today, second only to Fable 5.
kept_items.selection_reason: Major fresh model release news: Alibaba announcing Qwen3.8 open-weight, distinct from the Kimi story dominating prior days.

kept_items.author: DavidSacks
kept_items.text: Kimi K3 just fixed 15 critical security bugs that Codex and Fable refused because of cyber guardrails.
kept_items.selection_reason: High-engagement policy/competitiveness claim from the US AI czar on model guardrails; very fresh.

kept_items.author: benitoz
kept_items.text: Kimi subscriptions paused, GPUs maxed. Jevons Paradox with a CUDA bill. Cheaper intelligence detonates compute demand.
kept_items.selection_reason: Strong, well-engaged practitioner analysis on compute economics; distinct market angle.

kept_items.author: deedydas
kept_items.text: The story of AI is compute. K3 already #10 on OpenRouter with ~140B tok/day, infra crumbling, throughput and latency degrading.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete data on Kimi K3 serving degradation; different angle (infrastructure strain) from the celebratory coverage.

kept_items.author: DavidSacks
kept_items.text: Response to Dean Ball on regulatory capture; weaponization of regulatory uncertainty as a competitive tool should be unacceptable.
kept_items.selection_reason: AI policy/regulation debate at high engagement; distinct from the guardrails posts.

kept_items.author: aakashgupta
kept_items.text: Netflix paid $587M for a 16-person startup, InterPositive, whose model trains only on the dailies of one production.
kept_items.selection_reason: Concrete company/acquisition news with a novel technical angle (per-production models).

kept_items.author: matthen2
kept_items.text: Visualization of what a multimodal LLM (Gemma 4 12B) predicts as it watches a video, sampling from its next-token head on raw image patches.
kept_items.selection_reason: Strong technical practitioner content on multimodal model internals; good topical variety.

kept_items.author: kimmonismus
kept_items.text: Observation that most people are unaware of the scale, implications and speed of AI development; still a slow adoption phase.
kept_items.selection_reason: Widely-followed practitioner observation on AI adoption pace; adds analysis variety.

kept_items.author: Vvikramai
kept_items.text: Relays Demis Hassabis on how Google turned around the AI race in a year: relentless progress plus relentless shipping.
kept_items.selection_reason: Fresh leadership commentary from Hassabis; distinct company-strategy angle.

removed_items.selection_reason: Concrete secondary example extending the guardrails-hurt-defense argument; distinct angle.
